description: Live dark previews of a git deployment — one ephemeral .onion per branch. Every mainstream preview URL creates a public DNS record and a permanent Certificate Transparency entry, which publishes your branch names; these create neither. Returns each branch, its .onion, and when it expires. Use it right after pushing a branch to get the URL to share, or to see what is still running.

deployment_id.description: The PARENT deployment (dpl_...) — the one connected to the repo, not a preview.

name: impreza_list_previews
